mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id AS userId, m.stall_id AS stallId, m.name, m.description, m.logo_url AS logoUrl, m.business_hours AS businessHours, m.status, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, s.name AS stallName, m.average_score AS averageScore, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dish d WHERE d.merchant_id = m.id AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') ) AS dishCount, m.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, m.review_count AS commentCount FROM merchant m INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = m.stall_id AND s.status = 'OPEN' INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = s.canteen_id AND c.status = 'OPEN' WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = #{status} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.user_id AS userId, m.stall_id AS stallId, c.id AS canteenId, m.name, m.description, m.logo_url AS logoUrl, m.contact_phone AS contactPhone, m.business_hours AS businessHours, m.apply_status AS applyStatus, m.status, m.reject_reason AS rejectReason, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, s.name AS stallName, m.average_score AS averageScore, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dish d WHERE d.merchant_id = m.id AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') ) AS dishCount, m.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, m.review_count AS commentCount, m.approved_at AS approvedAt, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN stall s ON s.id = m.stall_id LEFT JOIN canteen c ON c.id = s.canteen_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(dish_stats.dishCount, 0) AS dishCount, COALESCE(dish_stats.viewCount, 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(dish_stats.favoriteCount, 0) AS favoriteCount, COALESCE(dish_stats.reviewCount, 0) AS reviewCount, m.average_score AS averageScore, COALESCE(recommend_stats.todayRecommendClickCount, 0) AS todayRecommendClickCount, COALESCE(feedback_stats.pendingFeedbackCount, 0) AS pendingFeedbackCount FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT merchant_id, COUNT(1) AS dishCount, SUM(view_count) AS viewCount, SUM(favorite_count) AS favoriteCount, SUM(review_count) AS reviewCount FROM dish WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY merchant_id ) dish_stats ON dish_stats.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT merchant_id, SUM(click_count) AS todayRecommendClickCount FROM merchant_recommendation WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND end_time >= CURDATE() GROUP BY merchant_id ) recommend_stats ON recommend_stats.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT merchant_id, COUNT(1) AS pendingFeedbackCount FROM feedback WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY merchant_id ) feedback_stats ON feedback_stats.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, d.review_count AS reviewCount, d.average_score AS averageScore FROM dish d WHERE d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY (d.view_count + d.favorite_count * 3 + d.review_count * 2) DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, COUNT(f.id) AS feedbackCount, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingFeedbackCount FROM dish d INNER JOIN feedback f ON f.dish_id = d.id WHERE d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY feedbackCount DESC, pendingFeedbackCount DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
